person: Anvita Kale, Class 4 teacher at Tekdi Lane Primary School, training for her first sprint triathlon, lives at Gulmohar Heights in Pune

mail.subject: Sarovar Sprint: entry confirmed
mail.body: Hi Anvita, your entry for the Sarovar Sprint Triathlon is confirmed. Race day is three Sundays from today. Distances: 750 m open-water swim, 20 km bike, 5 km run. Bib numbers and wave times will follow in the athlete guide. Entry fee paid: ₹2,400 (receipt RT-55128).

mail.subject: Aai Baba trip
mail.body: Tai, I'm sending Aai a new phone with video calling all set up. It'll come to your flat by courier before they arrive, so please keep it for her. Baba's knee is worse than he admits, so no fort treks please. And Aai is off sugar now too, not just Baba, so whatever sweets you buy, buy for both of them.

mail.subject: Fwd: E-ticket PNR 4827715903
mail.body:
Beta, ticket below. We reach on the Saturday morning. Baba

--- Forwarded message ---
TrackSeat e-ticket. Train: Godavari Link Express. From Ambarpur Junction to Pune Junction. Journey date: Friday after next, departs 21:15, arrives 06:40 the next morning. Passengers: Vasant Kale (64), Shalini Kale (60). Coach B2, berths 33 (lower) and 36 (lower). Fare ₹3,460. Status: confirmed.

mail.subject: Parent-teacher meetings
mail.body: Dear teachers, PTMs for Classes 3 to 5 will be held on the Tuesday of the week after next, 2:00 to 5:30 pm, in your own classrooms. Slots are 10 minutes each. Please have term portfolios ready and send me your slot list by the Friday before. Regards, Lalitha Venkatraman, Principal

mail.subject: Lane booking confirmed: 6 sessions
mail.body: Dear Anvita Kale, your early-lane package is confirmed: six 45-minute sessions in Lane 4 at 6:00 am on Mondays and Thursdays. Package price ₹1,500, paid. Please carry your membership card (MAC-20931). Note that the pool will be closed for filter maintenance on the Thursday after next.

mail.subject: Your build plan, weeks 3-4
mail.body: Anvita, good work on Sunday's brick. For the next two weeks: bike intervals Tuesday and Saturday, swim Monday and Thursday, easy 5 km run Wednesday, long brick on Sunday (40 km bike plus 4 km run). Taper in race week: nothing hard after the Wednesday. On the bike, drink about 500 ml an hour. And get the bike serviced at least a week before race day. Farhan

mail.subject: Service booking received
mail.body: Hi Anvita, we've booked your road bike in for a full service. Drop it off any day this week; it'll be ready 3 working days after drop-off. Full service ₹1,850. A new chain, if needed, is ₹1,200 extra.

mail.subject: Your monthly invoice
mail.body: Plan: Fibre 100. Amount ₹799 will be auto-debited from your saved card in 6 days. Account GB-448120.

mail.subject: Science park trip: bus and forms
mail.body: Hi Anvita, the bus for the Class 4 trip to Kalpataru Science Park is booked for two weeks tomorrow: it leaves school at 8:30 and is back by 1:30. Each class has 38 children and every child needs a signed consent form by the Monday before the trip. Each child pays ₹350. I've got 21 forms back for 4A so far. How many do you have for 4B? Rohan

mail.subject: Electricity bill
mail.body: Consumer no. 170244381. Amount due ₹1,684. Due date: 12 days from the date of this notice. A late payment charge of ₹50 applies after the due date.

mail.subject: Order AD-77421 shipped
mail.body: Your order has shipped: tinted open-water goggles ₹1,299 and silicone swim cap (pink) ₹349. Total ₹1,648. Expected delivery in 4 to 6 days with SwiftParcel, tracking SP90433812.

mail.subject: Zoya's absence
mail.body: Dear Ms Kale, Zoya will be absent next Monday and Tuesday as we are travelling for a family wedding. Could you please share the homework she will miss? Thank you, Fatima Qureshi

mail.subject: Appointment confirmed
mail.body: Hi Anvita, your follow-up for the left knee is confirmed for next Wednesday at 5:15 pm. Fee ₹900. Please wear shorts and bring your running shoes so we can check your gait.

mail.subject: Club kit: your tri-suit is here
mail.body: Hi Anvita, your club tri-suit (size M) has arrived. Collect it from Coach Farhan at any Saturday session. Balance due on collection: ₹1,100.

mail.subject: Annual Day rehearsals
mail.body: Dear all, Annual Day rehearsals will be every Friday from 3:00 to 4:30 pm in the school hall until the event. Class 4 is performing the Monsoon Song dance. Please send me costume measurements for your class by Wednesday. Thank you, Lalitha

mail.subject: Bike checked in
mail.body: Hi Anvita, your bike was checked in this evening. The chain is worn, so we'll replace it (₹1,200) along with the full service (₹1,850). Ready in 3 working days. We're open 10 am to 8 pm, Monday to Saturday, closed Sundays.

mail.subject: Open-water practice this Sunday
mail.body: Club open-water practice at Sarovar Lake this Sunday at 6:30 am. Meet at the boathouse. Wetsuits optional. Please bring a bright cap so the kayakers can see you.

mail.subject: Credit card statement
mail.body: Card ending 4417. Statement balance ₹18,342. Minimum amount due ₹920. Payment due in 15 days.

mail.subject: What to bring?
mail.body: Anvita, should I bring the pressure cooker or do you have a good one? Baba wants poha from the Ambarpur shop, I'm bringing 2 kg. And did you book his eye appointment in Pune? He needs the doctor who does the drops. Aai

mail.subject: Appointment for Mr Vasant Kale
mail.body: Dear Anvita, the appointment for Mr Vasant Kale with Dr Arjun Bhosale is confirmed for Monday after next at 11:00 am. Consultation fee ₹1,200. His pupils will be dilated, so he should not drive afterwards and should bring sunglasses. Please bring his previous prescription and a list of his current medicines. Ref ND-3318.

mail.subject: Report card comments
mail.body: Hi all, the portal for term report card comments closes 12 days from today, on that Friday, at midnight. Keep each subject comment under 60 words. Meenal

mail.subject: Sunday long brick
mail.body: Anvita, you in for the long brick a week from today? Meet at the Ridge Road petrol pump at 6 am, 40 km out and back, then a 4 km run. Bring 2 bottles. I'll bring spare tubes for both of us. Arjun

mail.subject: Your week in training
mail.body: 6 sessions, 4 h 50 min. Swim 3.2 km, bike 92 km, run 21 km. Longest session: Sunday brick, 2 h 10 min.

mail.subject: Maintenance closure this Thursday
mail.body: Dear member, the pool will be closed this Thursday for filter maintenance. Lane bookings for that day have been moved to Saturday at 7:00 am.

mail.subject: Re: Science park trip: bus and forms
mail.body: Thanks Anvita. The park needs the final headcount 3 days before the trip, so let's chase the last forms. Could you also be the first-aid teacher on the bus? Rohan

mail.subject: PTM slot request
mail.body: Dear Ms Kale, could I please have a PTM slot after 4 pm? I'd like to talk about Aarav's reading. Warm regards, Priya Nair

mail.subject: Courier for Aai
mail.body: Tai, the phone has shipped. Courier ref BX-55102, it should reach you Thursday or Friday and someone has to sign for it. Also it's Aai Baba's 38th anniversary on Wednesday next week. I've ordered a cake to your place for that evening, eggless chocolate. Don't tell them!

mail.subject: Your table is reserved
mail.body: Dear Anvita, your table for 4 is reserved for Wednesday next week at 8:00 pm in the garden section. Booking ref TC-6612. We hold tables for 15 minutes. Please tell us about any dietary needs.

mail.subject: Your bike is ready
mail.body: Hi Anvita, your bike is ready for collection. Total ₹3,050 (full service plus new chain). We're open 10 am to 8 pm, Monday to Saturday.

mail.subject: Staff meeting moved
mail.body: Dear all, this week's staff meeting moves from Thursday to Friday, 3:45 to 4:45 pm, in the library, because of the inspection. Agenda: PTM arrangements and Annual Day. Lalitha

mail.subject: Water tank cleaning
mail.body: Dear residents of Gulmohar Heights, the overhead tanks will be cleaned this Saturday from 8 am to 12 noon. There will be no water during that time. Please store water on Friday night. Hemant Gokhale, Society Secretary

mail.subject: Out for delivery tomorrow
mail.body: Order AD-77421 will be delivered tomorrow between 10 am and 2 pm. Someone must be available to receive it.

mail.subject: Medicines list
mail.body: Anvita, for the eye doctor: Glucoreg 500 mg twice a day, Lotensa 5 mg in the morning, Clarisol eye drops at night. My old prescription is in the blue file. Baba

mail.subject: Re: Sunday long brick
mail.body: Change of plan, let's start at 5:30 instead, it'll be hot by 9. Same place. If your parents are arriving that weekend you can skip, no stress.

mail.subject: Chidi's allergy
mail.body: Dear Ms Kale, Chidi has been diagnosed with a peanut allergy. Please make sure he doesn't share food on the science park trip. His adrenaline auto-injector will be in the front pocket of his bag. Thank you, Emeka Obi

mail.subject: Sarovar Sprint: athlete guide
mail.body: Hi Anvita, here's your athlete guide. Packet pickup: the Saturday before the race, 3 to 7 pm, Lakeview Expo Hall. Race morning: transition opens 5:15 am and closes 6:20 am. Your wave (Women 30-39) starts at 6:50 am. Your bib number is 284. Timing chips must be returned at the finish.

mail.subject: Swap duty?
mail.body: Hi Anvita, could you take my lunch duty tomorrow? I'll do your gate duty on Monday in return, since your dad has his eye appointment that day. Ananya

mail.subject: Dinner next Wednesday
mail.body: Anvita, thank you for including me in Shalini's anniversary dinner. I'm coming straight from the office, so I may be 15 minutes late. Shall I bring a garland? Mavshi

mail.subject: Shipment BX-55102 arriving Friday
mail.body: Your shipment from Neha Kale is scheduled for delivery on Friday between 9 am and 1 pm. A signature is required. To reschedule, use code 4471.

mail.subject: Group visit confirmed: Tekdi Lane Class 4
mail.body: Dear Mr D'Souza and Ms Kale, your visit is confirmed for 76 students and 6 adults, arriving at 9:15 am. Please send the final headcount 3 days before. Your lunch area is booked from 12:00 to 12:45.

reminders.title: Send PTM slot list to Mrs Venkatraman
Send costume measurements for Monsoon Song
Buy energy gels and electrolyte tabs
Buy extra mattress and pillows for guest room
Fill water buckets for tank cleaning
Buy spare tubes and CO2 cartridges
Race-day breakfast: bananas, peanut butter, bread
Book sports massage for after the race
